title: Each cell shows its rule in short words
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier D, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier E, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, one range: Default 35% markup, tier A 10% off, tier B $5 off, tier C Cost + $5.50, tier D 30% margin, tier E on Same as previous tier.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Default reads 35% markup, tier A 10% off, tier B $5 off, tier C Cost + $5.50 and tier D 30% margin.
  • Tier E reads Uses previous tier.
  • The grid has no "How it's priced" row.
  • Its rows are the cost ranges.
